title: Groundwater Contamination and High Fluoride Levels in Borewells
description: Villagers in Daltonganj block report severe yellowing of teeth and crippling joint pains among youth. Testing shows fluoride levels exceeding 3.5 mg/L, making local borewells hazardous for drinking.

title: Acid Mine Drainage Contamination of Subarnarekha Tributaries
description: Runoff from abandon coal and mineral quarries is turning local stream water acidic (pH < 4.0) with heavy orange precipitate, destroying surrounding farmland and killing livestock.

title: Widespread Sheath Blight and Leaf Blast Infestation in Kharif Paddy
description: Over 800 hectares of upland paddy in Mandar block show severe necrotic lesions and rotting stems, leading to anticipated yield losses of 45% among smallholder tribal farmers.

title: Severe Acidic Soil Degradation and Micronutrient Depletion
description: Plateau laterite soils have dropped to pH 4.2 with acute boron and zinc deficiency, causing stunted chickpea and mustard crops despite regular NPK application.

title: Arsenic Contamination in Shallow Aquifers along Ganga Basin
description: Handpumps across three diara panchayats produce water with arsenic levels over 0.08 mg/L, causing skin melanosis and hyperkeratosis among riverside residents.

title: Recurring Urban Waterlogging and Storm Drain Congestion
description: Monsoon rains submerge low-lying residential sectors and arterial roads under 3 feet of water for days due to silted natural nullahs and uncoordinated storm culverts.

title: High Neonatal and Maternal Anemia in Remote Forest Hamlets
description: Over 68% of expectant mothers in forest villages suffer from severe hemoglobin deficiency (< 8 g/dL) with zero access to timely point-of-care screening or antenatal monitoring.

title: Endemic Kala-azar (Visceral Leishmaniasis) Transmission Hotspot
description: Mud houses with damp cracked walls harbor sandfly vectors, causing recurrent spikes in visceral leishmaniasis and delayed clinical intervention.

title: Collapse of Rural Earth Roads in Heavy Monsoon Months
description: Kachha transport corridors linking farm markets wash out every July, stranding school buses and milk tankers due to un-stabilized black-cotton and mica-mixed roadbeds.

title: Post-Harvest Tomato and Cauliflower Spoilage in Tribal Belts
description: Farmers suffer distress selling at Rs 2/kg during harvest gluts due to absence of village-level pre-cooling or low-power cold chain facilities.

title: Uncontrolled Coal Dust and Particulate Emissions along Haulage Corridors
description: Continuous open dumper traffic from open-cast pits generates ambient PM10 concentrations above 380 ug/m3, triggering chronic obstructive bronchitis among roadside settlements.

title: Exploitative Middlemen Cartels and Price Distress in Lac Harvesting
description: Tribal gatherers receiving barely 30% of market value for raw sticklac due to lack of local scraping machines, standardized moisture assaying, and direct buyer linkage.

title: Language Barrier and Dropouts in Primary Schools of Santhali Pockets
description: Primary grade tribal children taught exclusively in Hindi struggle with foundational reading and math comprehension, leading to sharp dropout rates by Class 5.

title: Acute Water Table Depletion and Borewell Failure in Granitic Terrane
description: Intensive unregulated drilling has lowered the unconfined aquifer by over 14 meters in 5 years, leaving 70% of drinking wells dry before peak summer.

title: Unsegregated Open Municipal Dumping and Toxic Leachate Seepage
description: Over 120 tons/day of mixed municipal refuse dumped adjacent to natural drainage channels without bottom liners, contaminating adjacent shallow domestic wells.

title: High Transmission Losses and Frequent Outages in Off-Grid Mini-Grids
description: Decentralized solar micro-grids installed in hill villages suffer premature lead-acid battery failures within 18 months, leaving households in total darkness.

title: Severe Soil Erosion and Stream Siltation from Mine Overburden Dumps
description: Unconsolidated rock and shale waste mounds collapse during flash downpours, burying lowland paddy fields in toxic sterile grit and choking natural rivers.

title: Fall Armyworm (Spodoptera frugiperda) Outbreak in Plateau Maize
description: Invasive moth larvae causing whorl damage and stem tunneling across 1,200 acres of kharif maize, resisting conventional broad-spectrum chemical sprays.

title: Lack of Assistive Educational Tools for Visually Impaired Tribal Youth
description: Blind and low-vision students in regional residential schools lack accessible screen-reading tablets or tactile STEM learning materials in Hindi or local scripts.

title: Chronic Water Scarcity and Drought Vulnerability in Rainfed Upland Farms
description: Monsoon runoff quickly drains away down steep undulating slopes, leaving farms parched within three weeks of rainfall cessation and preventing second rabi cropping.

title: Low Remuneration and Quality Inconsistencies in Tussar Silk Rearing
description: Silk cocoon rearers suffer heavy pupal mortality and erratic filament denier due to lack of temperature-humidity monitored rearing sheds and disease disinfection protocols.

title: Under-Immunization and Vaccine Cold-Chain Gaps in Inaccessible Hills
description: Breakdowns in vaccine ice-pack carriers during 6-hour foot treks lead to compromised measles and pentavalent vials, leaving infants unprotected.

title: Fly Ash Slurry Pipeline Ruptures and Farmland Smothering
description: Thermal power plant ash pipelines develop undetected pressure fissures, spewing toxic slurry over 40 acres of fertile multi-cropped alluvial farmland.

title: Subsurface Coal Seam Fires and Toxic Gas Venting into Habitations
description: Unextinguished century-old underground fires cause surface land subsidence and expel sulfur dioxide and carbon monoxide fumes directly into residential bastis.

title: Absence of Soil Moisture Sensing Causing Excessive Groundwater Pumping
description: Farmers flood vegetable crops on arbitrary schedules using subsidised solar pumps, depleting community aquifer levels and exacerbating soil compaction.

title: High Incidence of Chronic Kidney Disease of Unknown Etiology (CKDu)
description: Abnormal prevalence of stage 3/4 renal failure among agricultural laborers with suspected correlations to organophosphate pesticide runoffs and heavy metals in well water.

title: Severe Deforestation and Illegal Felling in Sal and Mahua Forests
description: Dense natural sal tracts are undergoing rapid unmonitored clear-cutting along inaccessible ridges due to inadequate patrolling personnel and lack of canopy surveillance.

title: Low Digital Literacy Hindering Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) Scheme Access
description: Elderly and tribal beneficiaries lose days traveling to bank branches only to face biometric authentication failures and un-reconciled Aadhaar linkages.

title: Frequent Wild Elephant Herd Raids on Standing Crops and Settlements
description: Disrupted migration corridors lead wild elephant herds into paddy fields and mud houses during nocturnal hours, causing human fatalities and complete harvest destruction.

title: Erratic Biogas Yield in Community Digesters during Harsh Winters
description: Rural dairy farm community digesters stop producing methane between November and February as slurry temperatures plummet below 14 deg C, forcing revert to firewood.
